pyqs.stem: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT regarding epithelial tissue?
options: A) Cells are compactly packed with little intercellular matrix
B) It is avascular in nature
C) Free surface faces either a body fluid or the outside environment
D) It contains abundant collagen white fibre bundles
pyqs.answer: D) It contains abundant collagen white fibre bundles
pyqs.explanation: Epithelial tissue contains NO fibres in its matrix; collagen white fibres belong to connective tissue.

pyqs.stem: Cuboidal epithelium with brush border of microvilli is found in:
options: A) Lining of intestine
B) Duct of salivary glands
C) Proximal convoluted tubule of nephron
D) Eustachian tube
pyqs.answer: C) Proximal convoluted tubule of nephron
pyqs.explanation: PCT of nephron has simple cuboidal brush-bordered epithelium for maximum selective reabsorption.

options: A) Tendon — Specialised connective tissue
B) Adipose tissue — Dense connective tissue
C) Areolar tissue — Loose connective tissue
D) Cartilage — Loose connective tissue
pyqs.answer: C) Areolar tissue — Loose connective tissue
pyqs.explanation: Areolar and Adipose are Loose Connective Tissues; Tendon is Dense Regular CT; Cartilage is Supportive CT.

pyqs.stem: The ciliated columnar epithelial cells in humans are known to occur in:
options: A) Eustachian tube and stomach lining
B) Bronchioles and Fallopian tubes
C) Bile duct and oesophagus
D) Fallopian tubes and urethra
pyqs.explanation: Ciliated columnar epithelium moves mucus in bronchioles and ova in Fallopian tubes.

pyqs.stem: The function of the gap junction is to:
options: A) Perform cementing to keep neighbouring cells together
B) Facilitate communication between adjoining cells by connecting cytoplasm
C) Stop substances from leaking across tissue
D) Anchor cell to basement membrane
pyqs.answer: B) Facilitate communication between adjoining cells by connecting cytoplasm
pyqs.explanation: Gap junctions allow rapid transfer of ions, small molecules, and signals between cells.
